epic.title: Driver Operations & Trip Management Module
epic.body: Provides drivers with tools to manage daily trip lifecycles, track student attendance per stop, report incidents, and monitor vehicle maintenance and compliance requirements.

features.title: Live Trip Management
features.body: Enables drivers to execute daily pickup and drop-off routines with real-time status updates and student tracking at each stop.

stories.title: Trip Status Control and Dashboard
stories.body: As a driver, I want to start and end my assigned trips so that parents and managers can track the bus status.
acceptanceCriteria: Display: Dashboard showing current trip status (Not Started, Ongoing, Completed) and active route name.
Action: Provide a prominent 'Start Trip' or 'End Trip' button.
Metrics: Show real-time counters for 'Students Picked' and 'Pending Stops'.
Location: Automatically trigger live GPS updates to the backend once a trip starts.

stories.title: Student Boarding and Stop Tracking
stories.body: As a driver, I want to manage the student list at each stop to mark boarding status.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show an ordered list of stops for the active route.
Update: Ability to mark individual students as 'Boarded' or 'Absent' at their designated stop.
Search: Quickly search for a student by name within the trip roster.
Safety: Display student emergency contact details and photo for identification.

stories.title: Trip Execution and Boarding API
stories.body: Backend service to handle trip state transitions and student boarding logs.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Update trip status and log student boarding events with timestamps.
GET: Retrieve route sequences and student manifests mapped to the specific vehicle and driver.
Relational: Link boarding data to the Attendance module for centralized reporting.

features.title: Incident & Alert Management
features.body: Tools for drivers to report breakdowns, accidents, or traffic delays in real-time.

stories.title: Driver Incident Submission Interface
stories.body: As a driver, I want to report vehicle issues or road incidents immediately from my dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: Form to report incidents including Type (Breakdown, Accident, Delay), Severity, and Description.
List: View a history of incidents reported by the driver.
Media: Ability to upload a photo of the incident or vehicle issue.
Alert: Trigger immediate push notifications to transport managers upon submission.

stories.title: Incident and Alert Processing Engine
stories.body: Backend API to store incident reports and route alerts to appropriate stakeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: POST: Endpoint to create incident logs with geographic coordinates.
List: GET endpoint for drivers to see their specific incident reports.
Integration: Link incident reports to the Vehicle Maintenance module.

features.title: Vehicle & License Compliance
features.body: Visibility for drivers into the maintenance schedule and document validity of their assigned vehicle and their own license.

stories.title: Personal and Vehicle Document Tracker
stories.body: As a driver, I want to see the expiry status of my license and vehicle permits to ensure I am driving legally.
acceptanceCriteria: List: View status of Driving License, Bus Insurance, and Fitness Certificate.
Visuals: Display countdown timers for days left until document expiry.
Alerts: Show warning badges for 'Expiring Soon' or 'Expired' items.

stories.title: Vehicle Maintenance Schedule View
stories.body: As a driver, I want to view upcoming maintenance tasks for my bus so I can prepare for vehicle downtime.
acceptanceCriteria: List: View a timeline of upcoming and past maintenance tasks (e.g., Oil Change, Tire Check).
Status: Display the status of each task (Scheduled, In Progress, Completed).

stories.title: Driver-Scoped Compliance API
stories.body: Backend endpoints to serve document and maintenance data filtered by the driver's assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Retrieve compliance document statuses for the driver's assigned bus and personal ID.
GET: Fetch maintenance schedules mapped to the specific vehicle ID.
